items.hed: Houston steadied itself with a 110-100 win over Denver as Kevin Durant nearly reached a triple-double
items.insight: The official NBA game page lists Durant with 23 points, 12 rebounds and eight assists, while Alperen Sengun added 20 points. The Rockets controlled the closing minutes at Toyota Center and ended a two-game skid before returning to the league schedule.

items.hed: Randy Flores says the Astros are in the final stages of choosing their next manager
items.insight: Houston's new general manager told MLB.com at the GM Meetings that he hopes to finalize the decision by the end of the week, then turn to completing the coaching staff and roster plan. Flores said owner Jim Crane, Jeff Bagwell and assistant general managers Charles Cook and Gavin Dickey have taken part in the interview process.

items.hed: The Texans visit Cleveland on Sunday at 1 p.m. Eastern for their Week 10 test
items.insight: Houston's official game guide places the matchup at Huntington Bank Field on FOX. The Texans arrive after an eight-sack defensive performance and a five-touchdown day from C.J. Stroud, giving the road game a clear measure of whether that complete effort carries forward.
